purpose: Provides cancellable asynchronous composition, chaining, retry helpers, instance utilities, and Maid integration.
description: Provides cancellable asynchronous composition, chaining, retry helpers, instance utilities, and Maid integration.

Promise.luau.description: Promises, but without error handling as this screws with stack traces, using Roblox signals See: https://promisesaplus.com/ Public entry points include `Promise.isPromise`, `resolve`, `reject`, `Promise.delayed`, `returnSelf`, `syncronize`.

PromiseMaidUtils.luau.description: Helper functions for maids and promises.

PromiseRetryUtils.luau.description: Promise Retry Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Promise package.

PromiseTestUtils.luau.description: Utility functions for links. Links are an [ObjectValue] pointing to something else! Public entry points include `LinkUtils.createLink`, `LinkUtils.getAllLinkValues`, `LinkUtils.setSingleLinkValue`, `LinkUtils.getAllLinks`, `LinkUtils.getLinkValue`, `LinkUtils.promiseLinkValue`.

PromiseUtils.luau.description: Utility methods for promise Public entry points include `resolve`, `reject`, `PromiseUtils.delayed`, `syncronize`, `PromiseUtils.combine`.

Utility/PromiseInstanceUtils.luau.description: Promise-based utilities for working with Roblox instances. Provides async operations for waiting on children, descendants, attributes, and more. Public entry points include `PromiseInstanceUtils.promiseChildOfClass`, `PromiseInstanceUtils.promiseDescendantOfClass`, `PromiseInstanceUtils.promiseChild`, `PromiseInstanceUtils.promiseDescendant`, `PromiseInstanceUtils.promiseChildOfClassWithName`,…

Utility/promiseChild.luau.description: Wraps the WaitForChild API with a promise.

Utility/promiseWait.luau.description: Wraps the task.delay() API in a promise.
